name: Noise Marine

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the starter of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: This Threat has the Mark of Chaos (Slaanesh) (Wrath & Glory, p. 136)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Gain bonus dice and optional actions from Space Marine Implants (Wrath & Glory, p. 75)

abilities.name: Pandemonic Ecstasies
abilities.text: Anyone who can hear a Noise Marine must fail an Awareness (Int) Test or gain Hindered (2) until the Noise Marine is defeated.

options.name: Mob Actions
options.text: For every 6 Noise Marines in a Mob, one may be armed with one of the following. Apart from the Doomsiren, these options replace the Boltgun. Blastmaster: choose setting before firing (Single frequency or Variable frequency). The Doomsiren's Salvo is printed 1d6.

note: Resilience printed '12(5AR)'. Keyword 'MARK OF SLAANESH' is one keyword as printed. Print: 'starter of each' (sic). Doomsiren Salvo 1d6 can't be held (salvo is an int), so it's omitted and kept in the Mob option text. Determination has no 'Daemonic' text (not a daemon).
